limit-method-map.alt: A decision map for limits. Start by substituting x = c. A number means that is the limit. Zero over zero means rewrite by factoring, using a conjugate or combining fractions, then substitute again. A nonzero number over zero means the function is unbounded near c, so check the sign on each side. At a break point of a piecewise or absolute value function, find both one-sided limits and compare them.
